en.title: Snow in Slovakia today: how much is on the ground, 17 November 2026
en.description: Slovakia snow today, 17 November: snow cover, new snow, snow depth by height, the next days and the best resorts.
en.lede: 1,830 km² of snow-covered ground in Slovakia this Tuesday, down 190 km² on yesterday. In other words, 10 % of the mapped high ground is white.

sections.h: How much of the country is white
p: Below about 1,200 m the slopes are mostly green or brown. Last week's 1,710 km² has grown by 120 km².

sections.h: From the valleys to the summits
p: Average depth of the snowpack by height band: between 500 and 1,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 3 % covered; between 1,000 and 1,500 m, 1 cm on average, 39 % covered; between 1,500 and 2,000 m, 9 cm on average, 99 % covered; between 2,000 and 2,500 m, 17 cm on average, 100 % covered.

sections.h: What it means on the slopes
p: The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.
Three-day totals peak at 5 cm, around the High Tatras, the Low Tatras and Malá Fatra.
In the past day, up to 4 cm was added.
About 280 km² received at least 5 cm.
At the top of the list, Ski centrum Dedinky reports 42 cm.
Close behind: Vernár (36 cm), Kubínská hola (27 cm), Ski Zábava Hruštín (27 cm) and Vrátna (23 cm).
At Ski centrum Dedinky: 1 cm of fresh snow over three days, 0 cm more expected by Friday 20 November.
Vernár picked up 1 cm in the last three days and could add 0 cm by Friday 20 November.
Count 34 white resorts out of 107 in Slovakia today.
The week ahead could bring up to 12 cm, 7 cm of it in the next three days.
Monday 23 November stands out, with up to 4 cm in a day.

advice: Snow above the tree line can be wind-packed: watch the ridges.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.
Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.

sk.title: Koľko snehu je na Slovensku? Snehová pokrývka a predpoveď, 17. novembra 2026
sk.description: Sneh na Slovensku 17. novembra: snehová pokrývka, nový sneh, výška podľa nadmorskej výšky, ďalšie dni a najlepšie strediská.
sk.lede: Snehová pokrývka na Slovensku zaberá asi 1 830 km² (utorok, 17. novembra). To je o 190 km² menej ako včera.

p: Terén je prevažne biely zhruba od 1 200 m vyššie. V porovnaní s 1 710 km² pred siedmimi dňami je to nárast o 120 km².

Priemerná výška snehovej pokrývky podľa výšky: 500–1 000 m: priemerne pod 1 cm (3 % pod snehom); 1 000–1 500 m: priemerne 1 cm (39 % pod snehom); 1 500–2 000 m: priemerne 9 cm (99 % pod snehom); 2 000–2 500 m: priemerne 17 cm (100 % pod snehom).
Odmäk zjedá pokrývku: ráno tvrdý sneh, poobede mokrý.
Trojdňové úhrny dosahujú 5 cm. Najviac: Vysoké Tatry, Nízke Tatry a Malá Fatra.
Len za posledných 24 hodín napadlo až 4 cm.
Najviac snehu na horných tratiach: Ski centrum Dedinky, 42 cm.
Strediská so snehom na horných tratiach: 34 z 107.
Ďalej: Vernár (36 cm), Kubínská hola (27 cm), Ski Zábava Hruštín (27 cm) a Vrátna (23 cm).
Ski centrum Dedinky: 1 cm nového snehu za tri dni a do dátumu piatok, 20. novembra ešte až 0 cm.
Týždeň môže priniesť až 12 cm, z toho až 7 cm v najbližších troch dňoch.
Najsnežnejší deň: pondelok, 23. novembra, až 4 cm.

advice: Pred jazdou mimo zjazdoviek si prečítajte miestnu lavínovú predpoveď.
Pred cestou si overte, či vleky premávajú.
